title: Scholarship Programs
summary: AMP India Foundation offers scholarships and financial support so meritorious, underprivileged students can pursue education and build sustainable livelihoods.

programs.name: AMP Higher Education Scholarship
programs.description: Scholarships enabling meritorious students to pursue higher education.

programs.name: Orphans' Basic Education Support
programs.description: Financial assistance supporting basic education for orphaned children.

programs.name: Self-Employment Assistance
programs.description: Support that helps beneficiaries start or grow livelihood opportunities.

programs.name: Critical Illness & Medical Support
programs.description: Financial help for critical illness and essential medical services.

how_to_apply: Deserving students can apply through AMP's designated online crowdfunding and welfare application portals. Submissions are transparently verified based strictly on merit and economic need criteria.
